The 8-param SOFT cap is exceeded by 1; the function signature matches the backend RecallRequest contract (query/max_results/min_heat/directory/current_branch/default_branch/type_filter/tags/profile). Phase 2a: pure forwarder function — mirrors full recall() MCP signature (10 params) plus positional context (current_branch, default_branch) needed for backend. Decomposing into a dataclass would add a dataclass definition just to pass 10 fields to one call site — not worth it. All params are directly forwarded to the backend payload; same 'bundled MCP schema' rationale as recall() itself. Allowlisted: Phase 2a, #45.

Backend caching train Car 0 (#49): the unified backend Cache constructor mirrors the core yadgar/cache.py Cache (which sits at the 8-param cap: name/max_bytes/invalidation/key_fn/deep_copy/obs_tier/clock) plus one backend-only param, checkpoint_hash, needed to ckpt-gate the msgpack snapshot (a snapshot written under a different model hash must be discarded on load — the ce/embed model-swap contract). Each param is an independent, orthogonal cache policy bound once at construction; wrapping them in a config-object would add a dataclass indirection for a single construction site (the two _make_*_cache factories) with no readability gain. Allowlisted: Car 0, #49.
